body.note: Brown_bear torso and frame; beetle contributes only surface patches plus head horn, blend only at patch edges; thick supporting legs and rows of small breathing openings (spiracles) along the flanks

coat_color.note: Beetle reddish-brown glossy color at full strength inside back/flank patches only

coat_pattern.note: Few large beetle-type glossy blocks with clear edges on host back/flanks layout, no blending inside blocks

coat_texture.note: Hard beetle exoskeleton surface at full strength inside back/flank patches only; remaining coat is bear hair

face.note: Brown_bear muzzle and face; no beetle mouthparts

feet.note: Brown_bear plantigrade feet retained to support ~340 kg mass

head.note: Brown_bear head and brain tissue; supports bear-like feeding and senses

limbs.note: Brown_bear legs retained to carry host weight; insect jointed legs not used at mammal size - insect breathing limits size; thick supporting legs and rows of small breathing openings (spiracles) along the flanks

mane.note: Absent - brown_bear host has no mane

size.note: Host brown_bear size; all beetle parts scaled to host, no whole-animal dominance

skull.note: Brown_bear skull to house bear brain; no beetle head capsule

tail.note: Brown_bear short tail; beetle horn placed on head only, not tail
